boundary_scope: Artifact object imagery is an artifact identity/product pattern even when inserted into a listing rail.
intentional_differences: The observed 37:48 artifact geometry remains local to Amber Artifact.
label: Amber artifact imagery
reconciliation_rationale: The rail placement is event-media-adjacent, but the image belongs to the Amber Artifact product identity; placement does not create an Event Media component.

boundary_scope: Badge/avatar identity assets are Event Token Medallions overlays/extensions, not event primary/gallery media.
intentional_differences: Medallion crop, badge and product semantics remain independently owned.
label: Event Token Medallion imagery
reconciliation_rationale: The image is owned by the Event Token Medallion product pattern even when placed beside event media; the Event Media family must not absorb the medallion identity.

boundary_scope: Dedicated festival records, chronology policy and media layout do not consume the PreviewEvent Event Media contract.
intentional_differences: Chronology ordering and festival storytelling remain festival-owned.
label: Festival chronology media
reconciliation_rationale: Festival chronology media is evidence for a festival timeline composition, not for a reusable Event Media identity.

boundary_scope: Dedicated club cover/fallback belongs to club identity and catalog semantics, not event media.
intentional_differences: Club cover semantics and destination behavior remain club-owned.
label: Interest-club cover media
reconciliation_rationale: Interest-club cover imagery is a cover placement owned by the club product pattern and is only adjacent to event-media consumers.

boundary_scope: Transport maps/icons communicate route guidance inside a separate transport feature and do not consume event image semantics.
intentional_differences: Map legibility, iconography and route semantics remain transport-owned.
label: Transport map and icon media
reconciliation_rationale: Transport maps and icons are route-information placements, not event assets or Event Media component candidates.

intentional_differences: Metadata selection order and absolute-URL constraints remain output-owned.
label: output / open graph source media
reconciliation_rationale: Open Graph selects source media for metadata output; it does not render or own a visual component identity.

intentional_differences: Generated social canvas, copy and output dimensions remain channel-specific.
label: output / share social media
reconciliation_rationale: Share/social generation composes event data and media into output artifacts across several owners; source wiring does not prove a share-media component identity.

intentional_differences: Compact rows, desktop listing cards and mobile rails keep their observed differences.
label: placement / compact listing search media
reconciliation_rationale: Compact list, desktop listing card and mobile gallery-rail evidence has materially different geometry and interaction; no stable shared identity is proved.

intentional_differences: EventCard link semantics, content ordering and preview geometry remain card-owned.
label: placement / event card preview
reconciliation_rationale: EventCard owns a repeatable preview subpart, but current evidence does not prove it as an independent component identity outside the card.

intentional_differences: Hero copy, actions, action-panel placement and page ordering stay outside the primary-media candidate.
label: placement / event hero
reconciliation_rationale: EventHero composes primary media with hero copy/actions and responsive ordering; the media frame may be a candidate identity, but EventHero itself is a product composition.

intentional_differences: Exhibition deck ordering and page-specific interaction stay exhibitions-owned.
label: placement / exhibition deck media
reconciliation_rationale: The exhibitions deck combines a primary asset, thumbnails and viewer behavior inside an exhibitions-owned composition.

intentional_differences: Editorial rail, split rail, mobile gallery rail and lab EventMediaRail remain distinguishable.
label: placement / gallery preview
reconciliation_rationale: Gallery preview describes placement in companion, editorial, split, mobile and lab rails; those compositions differ and the lab rail is not proof of one subcomponent identity.

intentional_differences: CTA content, gradient treatment and destination behavior remain recommendation-owned.
label: placement / gallery recommendation backdrop
reconciliation_rationale: Recommendation imagery is a backdrop placement inside recommendation CTA composition, not a standalone Event Media identity.

intentional_differences: Portrait-poster legibility and remaining-preview arrangement remain coupled to the desktop companion.
label: placement / poster companion
reconciliation_rationale: Poster companion coordinates portrait poster media, companion copy and remaining previews; evidence supports composition ownership rather than a media component split.

intentional_differences: The standard hero-gallery candidate excludes efficient portrait/group viewers and preview rails.
label: placement / primary gallery media
reconciliation_rationale: This ledger category spans standard modal viewers, the efficient portrait viewer and exhibitions usage; standard viewer evidence is bounded separately, while the broader category remains unresolved.

intentional_differences: Protected-document contain and text-legibility behavior remains a mode-specific requirement.
label: semantic / ocr document
reconciliation_rationale: OCR/document is an asset-semantic mode that changes contain/crop and legibility requirements; it cannot own a component contract.

intentional_differences: Portrait poster crop protection and companion treatment remain mode- and placement-sensitive.
label: semantic / portrait poster
reconciliation_rationale: Portrait poster is a media mode used by several placements; aspect ratio alone does not prove component identity.

intentional_differences: Textual safe areas and legibility constraints remain explicit pending source classification.
label: semantic / textual artwork
reconciliation_rationale: Textual artwork is semantically distinct from photography even where current classification coverage is incomplete; it is a mode, not an identity.

intentional_differences: Unknown assets retain conservative behavior until classification evidence exists.
label: semantic / unknown text mode
reconciliation_rationale: Unknown text mode preserves uncertainty instead of defaulting to photography crop permission; it is not a component identity.

intentional_differences: Crop permission remains placement-specific and is not elevated to a global token.
label: semantic / visual only photography
reconciliation_rationale: Visual-only photography is a mode that may permit cover/crop behavior by placement; it does not define a reusable component by itself.

intentional_differences: Runtime broken recovery remains separate from initial missing state and typed fallback art.
label: state / broken media fallback
reconciliation_rationale: Broken-source recovery varies by consumer and is not equivalent to initially missing media or typed fallback art.

intentional_differences: Skeleton duration, geometry and replacement behavior remain aligned with the owning consumer.
label: state / loading skeleton media frame
reconciliation_rationale: Skeleton rendering is a transient implementation state owned by each loading consumer, not a standalone component identity.

intentional_differences: Generic empty, neutral and typed-art outcomes stay distinct.
label: state / no image fallback
reconciliation_rationale: No-image is a semantic state resolved by the owning consumer; generic fallback is not a component, while proved typed concert/lecture art is bounded separately.

boundary_scope: Analysis-only umbrella for all 52 event-media consumer applications; never a component contract.
intentional_differences: EventCard preview, primary frame, standard viewer, typed fallback art, rails, semantic modes and output compositions are not flattened into one component.
label: Event Media analytical family
reconciliation_rationale: The census proves a related analytical family, not one accepted component. The family contains placements, modes, composition patterns, foundations, details and unresolved boundaries, with exactly three independently bounded identity candidates.

boundary_scope: Single selected event-detail primary asset or typed presentation fallback in a prominent frame; viewer and hero composition excluded.
intentional_differences: The candidate remains versioned, reversible, non-canonical and excluded from migration until all gates close.
label: Event Primary Media identity candidate
reconciliation_rationale: Source anatomy and behavior prove a separately describable identity candidate, but no owner receipt, acceptance or physical normalization is implied.

boundary_scope: Only the standard .hero-gallery modal viewer; efficient portrait/group viewers and preview rails are excluded and unresolved.
intentional_differences: The candidate remains versioned, reversible, non-canonical and excluded from migration until all gates close.
label: Event Media Viewer identity candidate
reconciliation_rationale: Source anatomy and behavior prove a separately describable identity candidate, but no owner receipt, acceptance or physical normalization is implied.

boundary_scope: Only deterministic typed concert and lecture decorative art for initially missing primary media; generic and broken fallbacks excluded.
intentional_differences: The candidate remains versioned, reversible, non-canonical and excluded from migration until all gates close.
label: Event Fallback Art identity candidate
reconciliation_rationale: Source anatomy and behavior prove a separately describable identity candidate, but no owner receipt, acceptance or physical normalization is implied.

boundary_scope: Policy vocabulary for ratio provenance, fit, crop permission, object position, focal point and safe area; it cannot own rendering.
intentional_differences: 5:4, 4:5, 3:4, 4:3, 1:1, intrinsic and source-specific ratios remain consumer evidence rather than global tokens.
label: Media framing foundation candidate
reconciliation_rationale: Repeated ratio, fit, crop, focal and safe-area vocabulary supports a prospective framing foundation while consumer values remain local and no global ratio/token is selected.

boundary_scope: Analytical foundation for selection/loading/quality vocabulary; no global threshold, token or migration.
intentional_differences: Source selection, responsive sources, tiny-source handling and upscale thresholds remain scoped to observed consumers.
label: Media quality and selection foundation candidate
reconciliation_rationale: Selection, tiny-source and upscale evidence is shared policy input, but thresholds and source ranking remain product-specific pending runtime proof.

boundary_scope: Desktop efficient portrait media grouping/viewer only.
intentional_differences: Efficient-mode grouping, portrait geometry and viewer behavior remain excluded from candidate.event-media-viewer.
label: Efficient portrait viewer unresolved boundary
reconciliation_rationale: The efficient portrait strip/group viewer has different grouping, overlay and interaction behavior from the standard hero-gallery; evidence does not establish merge, variant or separate identity.

boundary_scope: Lab EventMediaRail source/specimen only; production ownership unresolved.
intentional_differences: The lab EventMediaRail remains evidence-only and cannot promote or define a production component.
label: Lab EventMediaRail unresolved boundary
reconciliation_rationale: A lab-only source binding and behavioral packet do not establish production ownership or equivalence with editorial, split or mobile rails.
